name: agent-output-evaluation-and-benchmark-harness
title: agent output evaluation and benchmark harness
description: Build an offline benchmark harness that runs a fixed set of golden tasks, scores the agent output, and tracks score/cost regressions across model & prompt changes. PR1: pure-logic foundation (golden fixtures + scorer registry); PR2: runner + persistence; PR3: API + async job; PR4: frontend Benchmarks page.
creator: jackmouse

subtasks.title: PR2: runner + pass@k/stderr + benchmark_run persistence + baseline pin
subtasks.notes: Done (commit d353579). 4 new modules: aggregations.py (pass@k HumanEval unbiased estimator + stderr + per_fixture + aggregate + diff), store.py (BenchmarkStore protocol + InMemoryStore + SqliteStore w/ PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON + partial unique index for single baseline), runner.py (IssueExecutor protocol + FakeExecutor + RealConductorExecutor thin adapter + BenchmarkRunner orchestration), cli.py (python -m benchmark.cli entry, --dry-run for smoke test). 66 new unit tests; 702/702 full backend suite, 0 regressions. RealConductorExecutor is a thin adapter that calls create_codex_issue + auto_start_issue_graph + run_issue_conductor_loop + reads back ExecutionProcess for cost/tokens + qa_workflow for CommandResults — not exercised end-to-end in this env because Mock is no-op; operator runs the CLI against real CLI to exercise the prod path.

subtasks.title: PR3: API endpoints + async job + LLM-as-judge + calibration set
subtasks.notes: POST /api/benchmark/runs trigger; GET fetch + baseline diff; LLM-as-judge scorer with human-labeled calibration set + correlation check.

subtasks.title: PR4: frontend Benchmarks page (trigger / leaderboard / score×cost / baseline diff) + i18n
subtasks.notes: Leaderboard grouped by difficulty/tag; score×cost frontier chart; baseline-vs-candidate diff; zh/en copy.

notes: PR1 done (commit 4c423b6, +1671 lines, 11 fixtures + scorers + 54 tests). PR2 done (commit d353579, +2516 lines, runner + aggregations + store + CLI + 66 tests; 702/702 backend suite, 0 regressions). PR3 + PR4 still pending.
